status: draft: the taxonomy under test, not decided. The D16 amendment (W-92) decides it from the evidence.
note: Six topics that own data and two computed views. The one-line descriptions are all a blind probe or a human grader sees (plan section 5.2): the discriminating words must live here, so if a description cannot carry a distinction, the description is what is under test. Do not add edge rules, rulings or rationale to a description.

topics.label: Temp & Humidity
topics.description: How the space feels: temperature and moisture (heat, cold, humidity).

topics.label: Air Quality
topics.description: What is in the air: CO2, gases, particles and an overall air-quality reading.

topics.label: Security & Presence
topics.description: Who is here and whether the place is secure: motion, doors, locks, cameras, water leaks and who is home.

topics.label: Energy
topics.description: What the building is using: power, energy, current and voltage of mains-powered loads and circuits.

topics.label: Connectivity
topics.description: Whether the household's connections are up: the internet uplink, Wi-Fi, the VPN, the Zigbee network as a whole, and whether a phone or hub can be reached.

topics.label: Device Health
topics.description: How one device is doing: its battery, its signal to its hub, its last check-in, and whether it is online.

topics.label: Alert History
topics.description: What went wrong and when: past alerts from every topic (a computed view, not a source of readings).

topics.label: Occupancy
topics.description: How busy the place is: a summary of recent motion and door activity over time (a computed view, not a source of readings).
